selection.summary: OCI storage backend config gaps confirmed on base: (1) internal/config/storage.go defines OCI struct with Repository, BundleDirectory (bundles_directory), Insecure, and Authentication (*OCIAuthentication) fields (h0), but has NO PollInterval field, unlike Git (h9) and S3 which both define poll_interval; setDefaults for OCIStorageType only sets "store.oci.insecure" (a mistyped key, should be storage.oci.insecure) with no poll_interval default (h8). (2) Validation exists for missing repository ("oci storage repository must be specified", h14) and invalid references via registry.ParseReference wrapped as "validating OCI configuration: ...invalid reference: missing repository" (h9), matching testdata oci_invalid_unexpected_repo.yml and the config_test expectations (h1, h5). (3) The OCI snapshot Source (internal/storage/fs/oci/source.go, h3) supports WithPollInterval option but defaults to 30s; config does not plumb poll_interval to it, and grpc.go wiring (h4/h11) does not import fs/oci, so bundles_directory/authentication parsing is only partially surfaced. Useful evidence: config struct/defaults/validation (h8, h9, h0), test expectations (h1, h5, h6), and OCI source option surface (h3).
